dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.text: 小南，这是你的新手机吗？
dialogue.reading: Xiǎonán, zhè shì nǐ de xīn shǒujī ma?

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Méicuò! Wǒ bàba sòng wǒ de.

dialogue.speaker: b
dialogue.reading: Shì ma? Wǒ yě yào xīn shǒujī……

dialogue.speaker: a
dialogue.reading: Yěxǔ nǐ bàba yě sòng nǐ!
